scripts.reset: docker compose --progress quiet --profile '*' down -v -t 0 && npm run start:quick
scripts.reset-start-all: docker compose --progress quiet --profile '*' down -v -t 0 && docker compose --progress quiet --profile '*' up -d
scripts.start: npm run build:cli && docker compose -p the_zoo --profile '*' build && docker compose --profile '*' up -d --no-start --remove-orphans --force-recreate --quiet-pull && docker compose up -d --quiet-pull
scripts.start:quick: docker compose --progress quiet up -d && docker compose --progress quiet --profile '*' up -d --no-start
scripts.start:ci: npm run build:cli && docker compose up -d --quiet-pull --wait --wait-timeout 300
scripts.start:fresh: docker compose --env-file .env.fresh -p the_zoo --progress 'quiet' --profile '*' build && docker compose --env-file .env.fresh --profile '*' up -d --no-start --remove-orphans --force-recreate --quiet-pull && docker compose --env-file .env.fresh up -d --quiet-pull --wait
scripts.start:packages: docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml -f docker-compose.packages.yaml --progress 'quiet' --profile '*' build && docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml -f docker-compose.packages.yaml --profile '*' up -d --no-start --remove-orphans --force-recreate --quiet-pull && docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml -f docker-compose.packages.yaml up -d --quiet-pull
scripts.test:fresh: npm run start:fresh && vitest run --config vitest.fresh.config.ts --reporter=dot; status=$?; npm run stop:fresh; exit $status
scripts.test:infrastructure: RUN_INFRASTRUCTURE_TESTS=1 vitest run --project live tests/infrastructure/database-reset.test.ts --pool=forks --poolOptions.forks.singleFork=true && RUN_INFRASTRUCTURE_TESTS=1 vitest run --project live tests/infrastructure/snapshot-round-trip.test.ts
scripts.fix: npm run lint:fix && npm run fmt:fix
scripts.precommit: npm run fix && npm run lint && npm run fmt && npm run typecheck
scripts.publish:cli: npm run build:cli && tsx scripts/verify-release-images.ts && npm test && cd dist && npm publish
scripts.publish:cli:dry: npm run build:cli && cd dist && npm pack --dry-run
